name: Creative Industry
aiPrompt: Write with warmth and energy while staying professional. Where it fits, mention a specific project from my resume and what made it work.
blocks: When I saw your opening for the {{JOB_TITLE}} role, I knew I wanted to introduce myself and some of the work I am proudest of.
The work I enjoy most starts with curiosity and ends with something people remember. I bring that mix of play and care to every brief, and I would love to bring it to your projects.
Thank you for reading. I would be glad to share more of my portfolio and talk about what we could make together.
